body: All round-1 items and the 40/30 ruling are verified. NEW blocking defect: bin/cargo:611 slot_is_held runs 'exec {tfd}>"$dir/slot-$s.lock" 2>/dev/null', and a bare exec with redirections applies 2>/dev/null to the whole wrapper. After any burst-slot probe, every compiler error and the queued notice vanish (reproduced: 0 error lines on burst-granted and burst-refused builds). Fix: '{ exec {tfd}>...; } 2>/dev/null || return 1'. Add a test that asserts stub cargo stderr reaches the caller on burst-granted and burst-refused paths. Same pattern at :576 on_signal (from #9); fix it there too. Non-blocking: reset burst_denied when a burst is granted. Round 3 covers this fix only.
subject: aida-host PR #10: round 2 CHANGES, narrow round 3 (one line): stderr swallowed
